title: Rosa Luxemburg Foundation International Doctoral Scholarship
summary: Doctoral support in Germany for internationally recruited candidates with strong academic results and engagement aligned with the foundation's values.

mandatory.text: Very good graduate degree, doctoral admission and supervision by a lecturer in Germany.
